mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.character_name, c.player_name, c.race, c.faction, c.current_classes_string, c.created_at AS c_created_at, c.updated_at AS c_updated_at FROM "character" c ORDER BY c.created_at ASC

SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.character_name, c.player_name, c.race, c.faction, c.current_classes_string, c.created_at AS c_created_at, c.updated_at AS c_updated_at FROM "character" c WHERE c.id = #{id}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "character" (id, character_name, player_name, race, faction, current_classes_string, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{characterName}, #{playerName}, #{race}, #{faction}, #{currentClassesString}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE "character" SET character_name = #{characterName}, player_name = #{playerName}, race = #{race}, faction = #{faction}, current_classes_string = #{currentClassesString}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
